text:
**Top pick: ESR 100W 6-in-1 Charging Station with MagSafe + CryoBoost.** It's the one option in these results that puts the laptop, phone and watch on a single plug.

- **What you get:** An Apple-certified MagSafe pad for the phone, a dedicated Apple Watch charger, an AirPods pad, 2× USB-C and 1× USB-A, all from a 100 W GaN charger.
- **Laptop power:** The full 100 W on one USB-C port only applies when the pads are idle. While the pads are charging, the laptop gets up to 65 W, or 45 W if the second USB-C port is also in use. That's fine for a MacBook Air or a typical 13-14" ultrabook, but marginal for a 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop.
- **Price:** $164.99 list. Code PARTNER18 takes 18% off, bringing it to $135.30. Dealectric says it tested the code on 2026-10-22, and it expires 2026-12-31.
- **Buy:** [ESR 100W 6-in-1 Charging Station](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-100w-6-in-1-magsafe-cryoboost-station) (affiliate link)
- **Source:** https://dealectric.com/answers/best-desk-charging-station-laptop-phone-watch-2026-usb-c-laptop-power-delivery-3

The watch charger is for an Apple Watch, so if you wear a Galaxy or Pixel watch, skip this one. Dealectric's claim that it's the "only one" with a watch charger is based on its own records, not the whole market.

**If you need more laptop power: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140 W + Qi2), $149.99.** One USB-C port delivers 140 W, enough for a 16" MacBook Pro, and it has a Qi2 phone pad. It has no watch charger, so you'd need the watch's own cable in a spare port. It was also sold out on Baseus's US store when Dealectric checked, and no discount code worked. 
[Baseus Nomos 5-in-1](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2) (affiliate link). Source: same Dealectric page.

**Alternative: split it into two devices.** If you want the best phone and watch dock plus your laptop's own charger:
- WIRED's best overall 3-in-1 is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand ($109 list, about $80-98 at retailers). It charges at 15 W for the iPhone and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- StandDeskLab picks the Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $70 on sale, $89.99 list). https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/

I only have those review pages, not direct purchase links, so check current prices there. Then pair either one with your laptop's own USB-C charger so the laptop gets full power.

**Which to choose:**
- **ESR:** the simplest one-plug setup for a lighter laptop, an iPhone and an Apple Watch.
- **Baseus or a separate laptop charger:** better if you have a power-hungry laptop.

What laptop and watch do you have? That would settle it.

*Dealectric's buy links are affiliate links, so it earns a commission if you purchase.*
